sentences.text: The gold loan FAQ excerpt shown includes the FAQ preamble and the definition of a gold loan, but it does not show any pre-payment charge term in the evidence provided.

The in-force documents shown that do state a pre-payment charge are the retail loan policy and the home loan agreement, which say 2% on pre-payment or foreclosure, but those are not the gold loan FAQ.
